description:
You are a Technical Marketing Manager auditing social media previews. Configure Screaming Frog SEO Spider to extract Open Graph metadata from 'https://crawler-test.com/'. 

STEPS:
1. Open Screaming Frog SEO Spider.
2. Configure 'Custom Extraction' (under Configuration > Custom > Custom Extraction) to extract two items:
   - Name: 'OG Title', Method: CSS Path (or XPath), Selector: meta[property="og:title"] (or equivalent), Attribute: content
   - Name: 'OG Image', Method: CSS Path (or XPath), Selector: meta[property="og:image"] (or equivalent), Attribute: content
3. Start the crawl for 'https://crawler-test.com/'.
4. Wait for the crawl to complete.
5. Export the crawl data (including your custom extraction columns) as a CSV file named 'social_tags_export.csv' to '~/Documents/SEO/exports/'.
6. Create a text report at '~/Documents/SEO/reports/missing_social_tags.txt' that lists the total number of URLs crawled, how many are missing OG tags, and at least 3 URLs that are missing them.
